cases.prompt: $click Prepare the next Click release in one approved implementation. Preserve the compact one-approval workflow while hardening five gaps: infer every recognized verification command's minimum budget class; reject arbitrary Python inline or script execution as verification; make a Git-backed final batch fail stale if it changes tracked or pre-existing untracked content; require a later UserPromptSubmit turn before passing or replacing a staged contract; and block update_plan throughout armed, staged, approved, and review workflows. Add deterministic regression tests, configure a repeated shuffled gpt-5.6-sol/max A/B suite with loop metrics, and tighten bilingual claims so the repository does not claim cross-project proof. Keep the standard-library-only Hook, MIT license, out-of-repository state, Manual fail-open behavior, per-turn bypass, and one-shot implementation after approval. Do not commit or push.

Add regressions and do not commit or push.
